description.value: Avenue Bistro is a family-run upscale casual restaurant in Comox, BC, helmed by Matthias Lingkost, a chef who previously owned a Michelin Star restaurant in Germany before immigrating to Canada in 2016. The kitchen focuses on house-made dishes that blend European culinary classics with locally sourced West Coast ingredients. Touring cyclists arriving in the Comox Valley will find a sit-down dinner destination with takeout also available.
